description.en-US: A Catechism of Christian Doctrine, No. 1, prepared and enjoined by order of the Third Plenary Council of Baltimore (approved 6 April 1885): the abridgment for First Communion classes. 33 lessons of the shortest questions and answers (numbered to agree with No. 2 and Kinkead's Explanation), with the common prayers, morning and evening prayers, prayers for Mass, for confession and communion, the Rosary, the Stations of the Cross and hymns.
description.pt-BR: Catecismo da Doutrina Cristã nº 1, preparado por ordem do Terceiro Concílio Plenário de Baltimore (aprovado em 6 de abril de 1885): o resumo para as classes de primeira comunhão. 33 lições com as perguntas e respostas mais breves (numeradas como no nº 2 e na Explicação de Kinkead), com as orações comuns, orações da manhã e da noite, orações para a Missa, a confissão e a comunhão, o Rosário, a Via Sacra e hinos.

sources.description: Project Gutenberg #14551, 'A Catechism of Christian Doctrine, No. 1: for First Communion Classes' (transcription by Dennis McCarthy from catholic.net files). Text of 1885, from a 1920s Benziger printing; the Mass, confession and communion prayers are from Fr Finn's Prayer Book for Catholic Youth. Tier A: public domain in the United States. Transcriber's notes and the Gutenberg licence removed. Question numbers follow No. 2, so there are gaps by design.
